title: Synapse bus configuration (synapse.config.json in the Synapse home)
description: People, owners, channels and the server address. Holds no secrets: keys live in <home>/.env, and a person's key is stored only as a scrypt hash written by `synapse set-human-key`.

host.description: Bind address. Keep loopback unless the machines share a private network.

allowRemote.description: Required for a non-loopback host. Needs a non-empty allowedHosts and a TLS proxy in front: keys travel in HTTP headers.

allowedHosts.description: Host header values the bus answers besides its loopback names, for example the TLS proxy's name. Every other Host is refused.

defaultProject.description: The project a request without X-Dev-Project belongs to. Must be in projects.json.

adminProject.description: Reserved for operator features; must be in projects.json when set.

systemSender.description: The name the bus posts its own notices under. No bot or person may use it.

people.description: Every person who may use the bus. A name not listed here is refused everywhere.

roles.description: owner: decides cards everywhere they are allowed. approver: decides cards. pingable: may be @-tagged by bots.

projects.description: Projects this person may act in. Omit or use ["*"] for all.

keyHash.description: Written by `synapse set-human-key`. Never put a plaintext key here.

accounts.description: External account ids for optional packs, for example { "discord": "<user id>" }. An id not listed here is refused by the pack.

owners.description: The people who own this bus. Each must be in people. Owners decide cards and are the default @-tag.

channels.description: The channel set. "all" (broadcast) and "direct" are reserved and always exist.

corsOrigins.description: Extra browser origins allowed to call the API. The bus's own origin is always allowed.

discord.description: The optional Discord pack. Off unless enabled; the core never loads discord.js. Set up with `synapse discord setup`.

tokenEnv.description: The variable in <home>/.env that holds the bot token. Never put the token itself here.

projects.description: Per project: which Discord channel mirrors which bus channel, both ways. Each Discord channel belongs to one project and one bus channel.

cards.description: The mapped bus channel whose Discord channel gets the project's decision cards. Default: code, else the first mapped.

public.description: Serve the dashboard page to non-loopback callers. The API still requires a key.
